editorial:
Imagine you are an Interpol agent who just lost your partner in a huge explosion. You are angry, heartbroken, and ready to tear the world apart to find the guy responsible. That is exactly where you find Kyle Connors. Even when his own bosses tell him to back off, he does not listen. Instead, he heads straight to India, diving headfirst into a wild world of spies and secret deals. You get a classic ninetys action vibe here, where the hero is a one-man army fighting against a conspiracy that feels way bigger than he is. It is a fun ride that feels like a globetrotting adventure with plenty of danger around every corner.

What really makes this work is Don Wilson. He is a legendary martial artist, so the fight scenes are the best part of the whole show. While the plot is pretty simple and some of the acting is a bit cheesy, it never feels boring because the pace stays fast. If you love old-school action movies where the hero beats up dozens of bad guys, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: After a lot of fighting and chasing, Connors finds the people behind the explosion. He discovers that the betrayal goes deeper than he thought, involving the arms dealer and corrupt officials. In a big final showdown, he uses his martial arts skills to take down the main villain in a brutal fight. Once the bad guys are defeated and the conspiracy is exposed, he finally gets the justice his partner deserved and can stop running.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school martial arts movies and revenge stories.
